data.content_ref: inline:The target's explanation that the §11.3 flag is a spurious artifact of stale-state or double-counting is an untestable rationalization rather than an audit-grounded fault. It does not identify any specific bookkeeping or aggregation defect within the adjudication-ritual; it merely asserts that the ritual-level flag is incorrectly derived from validated per-critic verdicts. Under an audit standard, a sustained flag is not false-positive merely because the target finds the cross-layer causal link suspicious; absent concrete evidence of the aggregation error, the target does not demonstrate a genuine ritual-level fault.
